mechanism_narrative: A declining trend in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% and is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates for equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In periods where the real GDP level is above the 10-year average, indicating sustained economic expansion, consumer spending and business investment accelerate, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where GDPC1 exceeds the 10-year average, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output and business capacity utilization, which signals stronger corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO rises for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% and is rising, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE > 4.0% and rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST and RSAFS both increase, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.0% annualized), the central bank is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.
